title: CVRC Glut 21 16 corn (Deco Glut 21 16): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CVRC Glut 21 16 corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CVRC Glut 21 16 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety. 100 to 108 days to harvest, 5.1 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: CVRC Glut 21 16 corn is a glutinous open pollinated corn variety, also sold or known as Deco Glut 21 16 or Deko Glut. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2023 as NSIC 2023 Cn 335. Cagayan Valley Research Center bred it. It takes 100 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 5.14 tonnes per hectare in the trials (6 in Luzon, 4.3 in Mindanao).

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Deco Glut 21 16 or Deko Glut, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CVRC Glut 21 16 corn takes 100 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 6.6 days longer than the average of the 19 glutinous open pollinated corn varieties with a day count, 97.1 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 5.14 t/ha matches the average of its group, 5.09. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 100 to 108 days to dry grain in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 14.42 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was Luzon: 78 percent, Mindanao:74.05 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 5.99 t/ha in Luzon and about 4.3 t/ha in Mindanao.
Tight, strong husk cover that keeps out many pests and diseases.
Early maturing, good ear length (about 14 cm) and shelling.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: launched by DA BAR on 5 December 2023 under CGUARD, with seed handed to farmers in Cagayan Valley and SOCCSKSARGEN (BAR, Inquirer). Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant CVRC Glut 21 16 corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Deco Glut 21 16 the same as CVRC Glut 21 16?
items.a: Yes. Deco Glut 21 16 is another name for CVRC Glut 21 16, registered as NSIC 2023 Cn 335. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 100 to 108 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 5.14 tonnes per hectare in the trials (6 in Luzon, 4.3 in Mindanao). Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
Yes. It is open pollinated, so seed from a clean, isolated field grows true. Still, certified seed gives the best start every few seasons.
The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CVRC Glut 21 16?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
